family: AMD Polaris (gfx803): RX 570 / RX 580, Radeon Pro WX 5100
notes: wave64; no subgroup surprises found. 24B Q4_0 on the RX 570: E2 router split over 64 cubes 5.09 -> 5.36 tok/s (LB_DD_FAST=0 turns it off), docs/ENGINE_VULKAN.md 10.2 table.

the upload ring is a vendored cubecl-wgpu patch switched by CUBECL_WGPU_RING_MB / _RING_THREADS / _POLL_CALLER (RX 570: 3.95 -> 5.38 tok/s); those are read by the vendored crate at stream creation, outside this layer.
the RX 570 had a 4 GiB BAR (ReBAR) once and then failed amdgpu init; the engine reports BAR and does not depend on it.
not_measured: any LB_* knob on Polaris beyond the router split
WX 5100 (8 GB, x8 slot): parity runs only
